name: Longest Duplicate Substring
statement:
Given a string s, 
consider all duplicated substrings: (contiguous) substrings of s that occur 2 or more times. 
The occurrences may overlap.

Return any duplicated substring that has the longest possible length. 
If s does not have a duplicated substring, the answer is ""
outputFormat:
Print a string which is longest duplicate substring (any).
If no duplicate substring is found just print "" (Without quotes)
constraints:
2 <= s.length <= 3 * 10^4
s consists of lowercase English letters
